_comment: Reviewed decisions for the King James Version witness (Scripture/KJV/Witness). verseCounts: chapters the witness divides differently from the edition data/kjv-verse-counts.json was counted from; the witness's division is kept. missingVerses: verses the witness lacks; they are shown as placeholders, never supplied from another edition. textOutsideVerses: headings, arguments and the prologue the witness prints before a chapter's first verse, by book, the chapter they precede (or end), the first words and the number of lines; they are not part of any verse and are not shipped. verseNotes: verses a reviewer should check; the text is not changed.
